system.description:
Apply only the Expertise benefit of this known stance.

You have learned to enter a powerful and intimidating fighting stance. You fight with one hand as a claw and the other as a fist to emulate the ferocity of a Lion or Lioness.

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6.

You gain a +1 bonus to checks and saves to resist gaining ranks of Demoralize or Shaken.

In place of one of your attacks granted by the Attack action, you can attempt the Demoralize Skill-action, using your Unarmed attack bonus in place of Intimidation.

Beginning at 5th level, Once per turn, if you would use the Demoralize Skill-action as part of this stance, make an attack as normal, dealing damage on a successful hit, and treating your attack result as the result of your Demoralize Skill-action..

Beginning at 10th level, the threat of your strikes escalate beyond just your person. When you would use the Demoralize Skill-action as part of this stance, you can instead make a Roaring Strike.

Roaring Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage]. All hostile creatures within 15 feet of your becomes targets of the Demoralize Skill-action, using your attack result in place of Intimidation.
